data.desc: Ingram Micro (NYSE: INGM) is a leading technology company in the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, it plays a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to a highly diversified base of business-to-business technology experts. Through Ingram Micro Xvantage, its AI-powered digital platform, the company is building an intelligent operating system for B2B, helping customers and vendors simplify operations, automate processes and accelerate growth.
